name: [UPD] Fight Ducks! 🐤
desc:
🐤 Welcome to Army vs Ducks! !

How to Play:
🪖 Buy a troop & plant it in your garden!
🐤 Your troops fight ducks for you!
💸 The ducks generate money!
🗡️ Buy more EPIC troops & flex your ducks!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
